<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>No active license. Please activate a license to continue.</span></div>

## Why it happens

No licence key is installed. This is normal right after installation, and it also happens after a licence is deactivated, for example before moving the installation to another machine.

## Fix it

1. Sign in as the system administrator.
2. Open the **License** page and activate your key. Activation needs internet access once.

See [Activate your licence](/docs/installation/licence/).

## Check that it worked

The **License** page shows the licence as active, and tenants can add devices again.
